log.listening: TV remote is running locally at http://{host}:{port}
log.listenFailed: The local TV server could not start. {message}

trace.ping: Answered a ping from the TV
trace.noReply: No reply from the TV after the PIN
trace.pinRequired: The TV is showing a PIN. Key {key} is not sent.

api.pinPrompt: Read the four-digit PIN on the TV and enter it here.
api.pinFirst: Request the PIN on the TV first.
api.pinSent: PIN sent. Try the remote with a button; VIDAA does not confirm pairing with a reply.
api.keyRejected: This remote command is not allowed.
api.pairFirst: Pair the TV with the PIN first.
api.deviceInvalid: The saved TV pairing is invalid. Pair again.

mac.missing: The ARP reply contained no MAC address for {host}. Reply: {reply}. Check that the TV is on and reachable.

vidaa.timeout: Timed out while connecting to the TV.
vidaa.unexpected: The TV sent an unexpected reply.
vidaa.noConnection: No active connection to the TV.
vidaa.refused: The TV refuses port {port}. Turn it on and enable Settings → Connection → Connect to a mobile device → Content sharing. Also accept data sharing under Settings → Support → Disclaimer and Privacy, then restart the TV.
vidaa.certsMissing: vidaa_client.pem and vidaa_client.key are missing in {path}. Put a .p12 file from the VIDAA app in that folder and start again.
vidaa.certsRejected: The .p12 file in {path} does not contain a VIDAA certificate.
vidaa.certsFailed: The client certificate could not be written: {message}
